notes.text: The page considers the quotient N of M by the symmetric group and writes extension (5). The four forms of the middle fundamental group occupy two offset columns with two separate vertical equalities. The following sentence calls this extension structure a little richer than the first line of (4). These are accounts of the source, not proved claims.

The author says the earlier conjecture is equivalent to the following displayed comparison with Autextlac and then gives an alternative Gamma quotient expression. The exact prose retains « faite|fait » and « à|: » as visible doubts. The completion wedge in the quotient is an upper-right exponent, not a second hat over T.

Each puncture set uses one continuous horizontal continuation stroke after the first comma, without a second comma before the last x. The minus macro reproduces the stroke and makes no arithmetic claim. Both witnesses regularize these strokes as ellipses.

In the third display the tilde-T subscript is written gν without a comma, the X exponent favors an, and only one closing parenthesis follows the set brace before the period. These physical peculiarities are kept without completing the mathematical expression. The four tiny ξ/j forms remain provisional despite the preferred basepoint interpretation.

The lighter-ink NB asks to determine the automorphism group G of the geometric modular topos and tentatively writes G=Im Sν. It continues « Sans doute » with a faithfulness assertion qualified by g=0, ν≤4 and two suspension strokes. The canceled word after barred M and the crossed closing punctuation remain uncertain. This is the author’s tentative discussion, not a verified theorem.

The final Question displays the map from Gamma to Autext of the hatted T and places a straight bracket under the whole parenthesized argument with pi_1(bar M) beneath it. A left brace introduces injectif ? and bijectif. The lower-right note visibly reads « (Sans doute il faut condition », then tentative « sur le », an unread short group, and « cf NB. ». Its lower and right edges are clipped; H’s ajouter and final closing parenthesis are not supplied.

The page has a top pencil 16 and a bottom-left pencil 30, each transcribed as a numeral but assigned to an unnamed hand. The NB and Question use lighter ink, which does not by itself establish a different writer. No watermark or pale background mark has been promoted to source text.

The two NB insertions G and Im each have a curved attachment guide, now reproduced rather than treated as extra parentheses. A suspected bracket beneath the diagram alias was checked on the original-coordinate crop: the strokes belong to the following prose « un peu plus riche », not to an extra mathematical decoration. No bracket is added there.
